title: What the Rain Keeps
poem: i.  They tell me the rain is only weather. Then why does it knock to be let in.
ii.  The mirror agrees with me, mostly. It is the mostly I keep.
iii.  I keep an inventory of tendernesses meant for someone else.
iv.  I remember a room I have never stood in. The light there is always late.
v.  What I miss most is a place I am not certain ever stood.
colophon: a skyline that blinks back; each refresh, a city that never was.
